```yaml
name: Fuzzing

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

jobs:
  property-tests:
    name: Property-based Tests (Hypothesis)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev]"
          pip install hypothesis

      - name: Run property-based tests
        run: |
          pytest tests/ -k "hypothesis or property" -v --tb=short
        timeout-minutes: 5

  atheris-fuzzing:
    name: Atheris Fuzzing
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    # Only run on main branches to save CI resources
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev]"
          pip install atheris

      - name: Run Atheris fuzzing
        run: |
          # Run fuzzing for 60 seconds for quick feedback
          timeout 60 python -m atheris fuzz_target.py || true
        timeout-minutes: 5

      - name: Upload crash artifacts
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fuzz-crashes
          path: |
            *.crash
            *.heap
            *.stack
          retention-days: 5
```
